item.title: A Village Burned, Its People Killed or Exiled. A Court Ruled It Was Genocide.
item.description: Zammona’s erasure was part of a wider campaign of violence against Rohingya Muslims. An international court found that Myanmar was culpable for the atrocities.

item.title: Gen Z Is Driving Global Political Change, Aiding Far Left and Far Right
